snippet.title: Bone March Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Bone March is a small arena survival game, pitting the player against an unending horde of cursed skulls. It features a two-joystick differential-steering control scheme, represented here by two magic crystals Skullboi uses to propel herself, each being controlled by its respective joystick.  Master the controls to survive for as long as you can.

The game's control scheme is inspired directly by Cyber Sled's differential steering hover tanks.  If you've never played Cyber Sled, the original Battlezone or the Katamari games, you may want to spend some time in enemy-free Reflection area to get familiar with the controls.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3838210/Bone_March/


Music used in this trailer by  @mrabdullahx2  : https://mrabdullahx.itch.io/
